entry.title: Citadel of Aleppo

terrainReference.basis: Native datum is434.1433m at the retained terrain center. Foundations and masonry slope skin follow the standard viewer surface.

entry.note: The native X axis follows the actual mapped entrance steps; placement heading-1.9600215196180855 restores the geographic southwest bearing. The hill foot is not a surveyed upper curtain. Coarse terrain smooths the moat and terraces. A native5m replacement outline suppresses only the mapped bridge; approach height hints are unset because the bridge is offset from the model anchor. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
